title: How to Make $1M+ With a Drone ($1.5K in 30 Minutes)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

stated_problem.quote: Like most dangerous thing you can do is inspect a roof.
stated_problem.speaker: Nick

idea.name: Drone roof inspection / roof condition documentation
idea.one_liner: Licensed drone pilot captures roof imagery and AI-assisted damage reports for insurers, roofers, property managers and home inspectors, with storm-surge work and add-ons like social media footage
idea.customer: insurance companies, roofing companies, property managers, home inspectors, construction and solar firms
idea.offer: drone roof condition reports (visual, thermal, 3D mapping)
idea.revenue_model: per-job fees ($200-1,500), referral partnerships, recurring contracts

key_quotes.quote: But for like a standard visual residential home, 2 to 400 bucks.
So, the experts say that you want to call it roof condition documentation specifically.
If you point it towards drone roof inspection near me, and then on the paid ad side, if you're bidding on drone facade inspection, that seems to be the winning ticket here.

claims.claim: Drone roof inspection is ~$350M within a $23B inspection market, ~14.5% CAGR
claims.quote: Within that market though, only $350 million are currently of drone rooftop inspections.
but average gross margins are 50 to 70%.
So, the software does cost some, but yeah, probably out the door less than 10 grand to really get up and running in a business like this.

claims.claim: Tom Powers reached seven figures/year in about four years
claims.quote: It was 175 bucks to take that, by the way. And now he is doing seven figures a year inspecting roofs.
Every time there's a storm, he makes 15 to $30,000 in inspections.

claims.claim: $30-40 per Google Ads lead, 50% close rate
claims.quote: You're looking at like 30 to $40 per lead and 50% close rate.

acquisition_channels.details: list contacts in roofing, insurance, property management, construction; roofing marketing agencies for 30% referral fee
bid on cheaper 'drone facade inspection' and city-specific keywords
target 'drone roof inspection near me', solicit reviews on the spot
sites farming out local drone jobs for practice

ideas.delivery: Check airspace/permits and weather, pre-map roof on Google Maps, fly ~2 hours on site, upload to inspection software for analysis; ~2 roofs/day solo
ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA Operator ID/Flyer ID, A2 CofC or GVC for commercial flights near people/buildings; flight restriction zones near airports; drone insurance (EC 785/2004); UK GDPR when imaging private property

idea.name: Aerial property photo prints sold door-to-door
idea.one_liner: Photograph farms/properties from the air and knock on owners' doors selling large framed prints (Uncle Clark sold 2x3ft prints for $250 with 60-70% take rate); could add on after drone roof jobs
idea.offer: large aerial photo prints of their property

key_quotes.quote: and he would fly them over farmland in northern Utah, Cache Valley, and take beautiful pictures of like properties, ranches, acorage, right?

claims.quote: Thank you so Yeah, it's $250. It cost him like almost nothing to get it developed because he was doing it himself.

acquisition_channels.details: show the owner the printed photo of their property

ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA drone rules; privacy/UK GDPR concerns photographing homes without consent; Consumer Contracts Regulations cancellation rights for doorstep sales

idea.name: Post-storm FEMA debris cleanup hauling
idea.one_liner: After hurricanes, haul brush in a plywood-sided trailer to FEMA weigh stations paid per pound adjusted for density

key_quotes.quote: And you would make freaking bank because FEMA needs the cleanup and and like they're paying out these funds and so so are the insurance companies.

claims.quote: Those guys were me. That was me as a 16-year-old.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Waste carrier licence required to transport waste; no FEMA-style per-pound scheme in UK

idea.name: Drone construction-site inventory documentation
idea.one_liner: Fly construction sites on a schedule to document delivered materials as proof for disputes, sold as a $50 add-on or recurring service

key_quotes.quote: these drone companies are actually going and they'll go and like on a specific day and they'll fly capture what materials are actually on site

idea.name: Thermal drone deer recovery for hunters
idea.one_liner: Use thermal drones to find wounded game deer for hunters, who pay thousands; grows via viral social content
idea.offer: thermal drone search for shot deer

key_quotes.quote: So, there is a company out there that are constantly going viral on social media that uses thermal imagery drones to find deer that have been shot by hunters, ran off, and who knows where.

ideas.other_uk_rules: CAA drone rules incl. night flying; Deer Act 1991 and landowner permission

idea.name: Stump grinding with on-the-spot review asks
idea.one_liner: Tyler's Utah stump grinding business ranks #1 locally by asking every homeowner and referring business for a Google review before leaving

key_quotes.quote: And his secret sauce was, I'm going to go and do Google reviews on on every single customer.

acquisition_channels.details: ask homeowner and referrer for review on the spot
